dogecoin.text:
DOGE coin is now worth more than the company that pioneered the assembly line! 

Dogecoin continued its post-election surge to become more valuable than 121-year-old Ford. As of last night, dogecoin had a market cap of $55.5B compared to Ford’s $44B.

Animal spirits are back! https://t.co/KhtLkcsKt5

While all cryptocurrencies have popped since Election Day, Elon Musk’s preferred token, dogecoin, stands out with a ~157% gain. But at a price of around 40 cents, it remains far below its record high of 72 cents from 2021 @BusinessInsider
